set.description: 概率是衡量随机事件发生可能性大小的数，等可能事件的概率等于所求结果数除以总结果数。

criteria: 能判断一个数是奇数还是偶数
能说出偶数的个位特征
set.description: 知道偶数是 2 的倍数，不能被 2 整除的是奇数。
set.name: Odd and even numbers

criteria: 能说出分母表示平均分成了几份
能在具体量里说出一个分数表示多少
set.description: 理解分数表示把整体平均分后的几份，分母是平均分的份数，分子是取出的份数。
set.name: Meaning of Fractions

criteria: 能列出所有等可能结果
能求概率
set.description: 列出所有等可能结果，数出符合条件的结果数求概率。
set.name: Finding Probability by Enumeration

criteria: 能判断情形是否要分步相乘
能计算各步办法数的乘积
set.description: 完成一件事要依次做若干步，每步的办法数相乘就是总办法数。
set.name: Multiplication Principle of Counting

criteria: 能判断情形是否要分类相加
能计算互斥类别的办法总数
set.description: 完成一件事有若干类办法，类与类互斥，总办法数等于各类办法数相加。
set.name: Addition Principle of Counting

criteria: 能用乘法计算两个独立事件同时发生的概率
能说出独立和互斥不同
set.description: 知道若 P(A∩B)=P(A)P(B)，则 A 与 B 相互独立。独立不是互斥。
set.name: Independence of Events

criteria: 能判断两个事件是否互斥
能计算互斥事件的并的概率
set.description: 会用互斥事件的加法：P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B)。也会用容斥处理不互斥的情形。
set.name: Addition of Probabilities

criteria: 能判断事件类别
能举出各类事件的例子
set.description: 区分随机事件、必然事件和不可能事件。

set.nameZh: 随机事件、必然事件与不可能事件

知道分母表示平均分成的份数

set.reason: Probability endpoints and uncertainty require the event categories.
set.scope: probability of random, certain, impossible events

set.reason: Favorable outcomes give a fraction of a finite equal-likelihood whole.
set.scope: probability as favorable over total

set.reason: Outcome enumeration becomes probability through the favorable-over-total rule.
set.scope: computing probability as favorable over total outcomes

set.reason: Outcome enumeration provides concrete practice partitioning and counting finite outcomes. Probability ratios are unnecessary, as Gemini notes, but that does not erase the useful enumeration component.
set.scope: counting outcomes across disjoint cases

set.reason: Contrasting disjoint alternatives with sequential choices helps choose an operation. An array of shirts and trousers establishes the product principle independently of the addition rule.
set.scope: recognizing sequential steps and multiplying

set.reason: The explicit even-number units-digit criterion is the multiple-of-two units-digit test. The multiple-of-five part of the endpoint is outside this required scope.
set.scope: stating the units-digit feature of even numbers

set.reason: A general fraction takes several equal unit parts; one such part is the unit-fraction concept directly contained in that construction.
set.scope: fraction as a count of unit fractional parts

criteria: 能说出概率的取值范围
能计算简单的等可能事件概率
set.description: 概率是衡量随机事件发生可能性大小的数，等可能事件的概率等于所求结果数除以总结果数。
set.name: The Meaning of Probability and the Probability of Equally Likely Events
set.nameZh: 概率的意义与等可能事件的概率

能说出偶数的个位特征

set.name: Odd and even numbers

criteria: 能说出分母表示平均分成了几份
能在具体量里说出一个分数表示多少
set.description: 理解分数表示把整体平均分后的几份，分母是平均分的份数，分子是取出的份数。
set.name: Meaning of Fractions

criteria: 能列出所有等可能结果
能求概率
set.description: 列出所有等可能结果，数出符合条件的结果数求概率。
set.name: Finding Probability by Enumeration

criteria: 能判断情形是否要分步相乘
能计算各步办法数的乘积
set.description: 完成一件事要依次做若干步，每步的办法数相乘就是总办法数。
set.name: Multiplication Principle of Counting

criteria: 能判断情形是否要分类相加
能计算互斥类别的办法总数
set.description: 完成一件事有若干类办法，类与类互斥，总办法数等于各类办法数相加。
set.name: Addition Principle of Counting

criteria: 能用乘法计算两个独立事件同时发生的概率
能说出独立和互斥不同
set.description: 知道若 P(A∩B)=P(A)P(B)，则 A 与 B 相互独立。独立不是互斥。
set.name: Independence of Events

criteria: 能判断两个事件是否互斥
能计算互斥事件的并的概率
set.description: 会用互斥事件的加法：P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B)。也会用容斥处理不互斥的情形。
set.name: Addition of Probabilities
